issues.quote: lifting R&D expense to $21.9 billion in fiscal 2022 from $21.9 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Apple's fiscal 2022 R&D expense was about $26.3 billion, up from $21.9 billion in fiscal 2021 (roughly 20% growth). Using the same figure for both years also contradicts the word 'lifting'.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, margins and EPS match Apple's reported fiscal 2022 figures. The fiscal 2022 R&D figure is wrong: it was about $26.3B, not $21.9B.
